extras: Interface available in Russian; designed for mobile use and operates entirely locally without external servers or accounts.
motivation: Личное пространство для задач, календаря, планов, целей и привычек. Интерфейс на русском, светлая и тёмная темы, адаптив для узких панелей и телефона. Без аккаунта, сервера, аналитики и внешних ресурсов.
problem: Users need a powerful, self-contained system for managing complex personal plans, goals, and habits directly within local Markdown files without relying on external services.
summary: A comprehensive personal planning tool that manages tasks, goals, habits, and calendars using standard Markdown files within Obsidian.
